where: Worked example 2 (and Exam traps, last bullet)
problem: The example calls the change 'motion-gated recording' and says the site 'records only 20% of each day'. This reads as if the motion gate itself reduced storage, which is exactly what the last exam trap and quiz Q4 deny. A student can come away with two opposite rules.
fix: Say the campus moves to an event-only recording policy, where only clips around motion events are written, so 20% of the day is recorded. Keep the motion gate described as a compute saver, and state that the gate cuts storage only when the recording policy is switched to event-only.
